newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Hocheng Jan-Aug sales down.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Hocheng Jan-Aug sales down.

text.p: Taiwan's largest sanitary-ware maker Hocheng Corp. said on Thursday its combined sales revenue between January and August fell 23.42 percent to T$3.181 billion from T$4.154 billion in the same period a year earlier.
In the month of August, Hocheng's sales were T$370 million, down 28.02 percent year on year, a company statement said.
The company did not give reasons for the falls, and profit figures were not available in the statement.
